class.xss: HTML, script, CSS or XML injection into a rendered page or document, including DOM clobbering gadgets (CWE-79, 80, 83, 91, 116).
class.headers-cookies: CR/LF or attribute injection into HTTP headers, cookies or SSE fields, and cookie parsing confusion (CWE-113, 74).
class.code-execution: Remote or local code execution: command injection, deserialization, code built from input, memory corruption in native dependencies (CWE-77, 94, 502, 125, 787, 1395).
class.path-traversal: Reading or writing files outside an allowed root, including server.fs bypasses and zip-slip (CWE-22, 23, 50, 58, 69, 73, 177, 178, 180, 706).
class.ssrf: Server-side requests to attacker-chosen hosts, including image proxy allowlist bypasses (CWE-918, 441, 183, 625).
class.host-header: Host or X-Forwarded-Host trusted without validation.
class.authz-bypass: Middleware, routing or authorization checks bypassed (CWE-285, 288, 284, 306, 639, 647, 862, 863, 187, 174).
class.csrf-origin: CSRF protections, origin validation and CORS (CWE-352, 346, 1385, 942).
class.cache: Cache poisoning, deception and cross-user cache leaks (CWE-524, 525, 349, 436, 328).
class.info-disclosure: Exposure of source, secrets, tokens or other users' data (CWE-200, 201, 209, 219, 497, 522, 488, 362).
class.crypto-auth: Signature verification, JWT handling, timing-safe comparison, nonce reuse (CWE-347, 208, 323, 1284).
class.ip-validation: IP allow/deny lists and client-IP trust (CWE-185, 1289, 345, 636).
class.trust-boundary: VS Code workspace trust, restricted mode, agent and MCP confirmations.
class.unspecified: MSRC entries that give only an impact label (RCE, EoP, spoofing, information disclosure).

lint.flagged: A rule in an Ultracite preset reports the vulnerable construct itself, and doing what it asks removes the vulnerability.
lint.sink-only: A rule reports the sink or line involved but not the defect: it fires the same way on safe code, or for a different weakness, and the fix doesn't change it.
lint.not-flagged: Nothing in the presets reports the vulnerable code; the defect is a missing or wrong check, escape, canonicalization, limit or configuration.
lint.unknown: The advisory gives too little detail to judge.

basis.fix-lint: The fix commit was fetched and both versions of its changed source files were linted (advisory-fixes.json).
basis.summary+corpus: Advisory text plus the code at the pinned corpus SHA.

note: Repository advisories and reviewed global advisories (npm), de-duplicated by GHSA id; withdrawn advisories dropped. VS Code publishes no npm package, so only its repository advisories are included.
